name: Stroganina
effect:
Increases all party members' ATK by 66–95 for 300s.
In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
description: Sliced fish strips. Cut with a sharp blade at an angle across the surface of a whole frozen fish, shaving off thin, curling strips. Usually served with coarse salt, this is a common raw cold platter in Snezhnaya.

suspicious.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 66 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
suspicious.description: Sliced fish strips. The thicker parts are so frozen they might chip a tooth, while the thinner parts have already melted into mush... At the very least, under Snezhnaya's freezing temperatures, you probably won't have to worry about an upset stomach.

normal.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 81 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
normal.description: Sliced fish strips. Cut with a sharp blade at an angle across the surface of a whole frozen fish, shaving off thin, curling strips. Usually served with coarse salt, this is a common raw cold platter in Snezhnaya.

delicious.effect: Increases all party members' ATK by 95 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
delicious.description: Sliced fish strips. Paper-thin ribbons of meat are piled in the dish like a small cluster of ice-sculpted petals. Pinch a piece into your mouth, and the crisp, clean sweetness hits the tip of your tongue with the fresh embrace of melting snow.
